resources.string: Controls the requested GPS acquisition frequency. At 5 minutes or longer, GPS is released between single acquisitions. New fixes are published when available; the operating system, signal and network can delay them. Exact intervals and notifications are not guaranteed.
Compares the estimated GPS accuracy with a threshold in metres. An alert appears when accuracy exceeds it; this setting does not improve GPS or change shared precision.
